assumptions: TRLs are author assessments per Horizon Europe/EC definitions (EC FAQ + EURAXESS hardware scale); papers rarely state TRL. Full text of paywalled papers judged from metadata/abstracts. See information.md Section 11 for guide links.
funding_note: Internal R&D ~560-750k/year (4% of 18.7M 2025 turnover); bigger pilots via EU co-funding (Europe's Rail JU / Horizon Europe).
sector: Rail (railway: train, tram, metro, rolling stock, bogie, infrastructure)

trends.category_justification: Hydrogen bus experience (B4IA) transfers; rail application is new, same technology family and clients.
trends.description: Hydrogen fuel-cell trains for regional and shunting services where electrification is uneconomic. Only water as exhaust.

sources.note: 10,000+ passengers in the Americas, hydrogen mobility award

trends.title: Hydrogen fuel-cell trains
trends.trl_justification: Operational prototype with years of passenger service (Germany + Americas). Not yet fleet-wide commercial, so 7 not 8.

trends.category_justification: Builds on BLUE bogie/simulation core for the same rail clients; predictive service itself is new (not sold today).

demo_dataset.note: Proxy for dashboard demo only, NOT TRL evidence. Real pilot would use fleet vibration data.

trends.description: Live virtual replica of the bogie (frame, wheels, suspension) fed by vibration/temperature/strain sensors. AI predicts failures weeks ahead and optimises maintenance timing.

sources.note: HGKN-SINDy + residual graphs for high-speed bogie fault diagnosis (AI layer)
Digital-twin ML for real-time curve-negotiation dynamics (twin layer)
A2C reinforcement learning + digital twins for maintenance decisions (decision layer)

trends.title: AI-driven bogie digital twin
trends.trl_justification: Components validated in lab (Zhang TRL4, Dong TRL5, Mutlu TRL3-4); integrated system in simulated lab environment, no fleet demo, so overall TRL 5 per EC/EURAXESS scale.

trends.category_justification: Drone + AI capability from SMAIL-AI transfers; rolling-stock application is new (SMAIL-AI covers power lines, not trains).
trends.description: Cameras on trains/track plus machine vision to detect rail, fastener and wheel defects in real time, complementing human inspection.

sources.note: Review of defect detection in tracks and rolling stock
10-defect model, Bane NOR Norway, deployed in Maximo

trends.title: AI visual inspection of track and wheels
trends.trl_justification: Prototypes demonstrated in relevant environments (IBM model, drone pilots, SMAIL-AI active 2025-27). Not fleet commercial, so 6 not 7.

trends.category_justification: Design skill is core but circular lifecycle service is new; business model shifts toward lifecycle, same clients.
trends.description: Design for disassembly with recyclable interiors and carbodies so end-of-life trains become material banks instead of waste.

sources.note: DFD + 10R review for TRACK infrastructure (concept transfers to carbody disassembly)

trends.title: Circular rolling stock (design for disassembly)
trends.trl_justification: Methods and whitepapers validated in lab; SNCF disassembly is end-of-life practice, design of new circular stock still low-fidelity, so TRL 4.

trends.category_justification: Driverless operation changes regulation, operations and business model; far from current design contracting.
trends.description: Grades of Automation GoA3 (driverless with attendant) to GoA4 (unattended) for metros first, then freight and regional lines.
trends.title: Autonomous trains (GoA3/GoA4)
trends.trl_justification: GoA4 metros operational (TRL 7) but mainline/freight still in testing (TRL 4-5); trend overall demonstrated in relevant environment, so TRL 6 with metro/mainline note.

trends.category_justification: Shape-memory alloy experience from ARIA transfers; rail application is new.
trends.description: Lightweight structures with shape-memory-alloy morphing elements for adaptive aerodynamics and vibration control on rolling stock.

sources.note: SMA bistable morphing spoiler for adaptive aerodynamics

trends.title: Lightweight SMA morphing structures
trends.trl_justification: Lab validation (Riccio/Battaglia + BLUE ARIA); no rail deployment, so TRL 4.
